content: Allison: HhhHHhHHHh
narrator: I looked up from my phone as Allison walked into the room, slumped over. She walked over and faceplanted onto the bed I was sitting on. I looked at her inquisitively.
Saturday: What's got you all tuckered out?
Allison: Mmmf.
narrator: I leaned over and poked her hair.
Saturday: Sit up, Alli. I can't make out a word you're saying.
narrator: Allison sat up.
Allison: Packing. The same thing we've been doing all day.
Saturday: Well, speak for yourself. I finished up pretty early, actually.
Allison: Yeah, because you don't have anything to pack... all your stuff is still back at home on the island.
Saturday: Hey, don't fault me for being lightweight to travel! I don't need much to get by. You're the one that had, like, everything shipped from Tanegashima.
narrator: Allison glared at me with an unserious, tired expression.
Allison: Yeah, and I've realized now how bad of an idea that was. Because now I have to get it all shipped back.
Saturday: Such is the struggle with a temporary home.
Allison: Sure is. How about you? You already packed everything up?
Saturday: Yeah, did it this afternoon. Didn't really take too long, like I said.
Allison: Maybe I should loosen up a little. I'm admittedly a little envious of your single carry-on suitcase.
Saturday: Ha! Well, it certainly makes traveling easier. But I'd be lying if I said I didn't miss my home back on Tanegashima. So, take that as you will.
Allison: -chuckles- Fair enough.
narrator: Just then, a rather tall silhouette appeared in the doorway.
Saturday: Hey, Kotomi! What's up?
narrator: Kotomi walked into the room.
Kotomi: Nothing much, just making sure you're both ready to be up early tomorrow for the taxi to the airport. Everything all ready?
Saturday: Yup!
Kotomi: ...I know you're ready, Sat. I was mainly talking to Allison.
Allison: Yeah, I just finished up. All the stuff that's getting shipped back is in the boxes by the front door, and my suitcases are in my room.
Kotomi: Cool cool, Eri and I also just finished packing. Don't stay up too late! We've gotta be up at 8 AM sharp tomorrow.
Saturday: You got it!
narrator: Kotomi left the room and closed the door behind her, leaving Allison and I in the light of the dim desktop lamp on the dresser.
narrator: Allison looked over at my phone in my hand.
Allison: What were you doing?
narrator: I turned on the phone to reveal the game I'd been playing.
Saturday: Putting in some of the grind on NOIZS SUNLIVHT. Trying to clear that Chapter 5 update that just came out.
narrator: Allison gives a lighthearted chuckle.
Allison: Oh, I should've known.
narrator: I felt a light impact against my side and looked over to see Allison resting her head on my shoulder. I gave her a teasing smile.
Saturday: You want to rest your head on my lap?
narrator: Allison moved away from me, flustered.
Allison: Whuh?! I- I mean, I wasn't- I just, was like,
Saturday: You want to rest your head on my lap.
narrator: Allison buried her face in her knees.
Allison: yeah,
narrator: I put my legs down off the bed and let Allison lay down on my lap. I looked down at her, still flustered, with her eyes closed.
Saturday: Hey, hey... you can't fall asleep there, you know...

Saturday: Hey, hey... you can't fall asleep there, you know, we still have some time before Kotomi comes to check on us again. Besides, I think it's cute when you're all snuggled up in my lap like that.

Allison: *sigh* Sorry... I just really don't want to be here right now. And I don't mean the apartment, I mean this whole situation. We didn't plan for this and I'm not sure how we're going to make it work.

Saturday: I know, baby, I feel you. But we'll figure it out together, okay? We always do. And who knows, maybe this is an opportunity for us to grow closer, away from the distractions of our daily lives.

Allison: *opens her eyes, looking at Saturday with a mix of sadness and longing* You really think so?

Saturday: Yeah... I do. And even if things get tough, we have each other's backs. That's what matters most, right?

Allison: *nods slightly, then leans in to rest her head on Saturday's shoulder again*

Saturday: So, tell me more about these feelings you're having. What's really going on inside that beautiful mind of yours?

Saturday: Shh, don't fall asleep, Alli. We still have to get up early.

Allison: Mmm... just need a minute...

Saturday: (gently stroking her hair) I know you're exhausted, but we really can't afford to sleep in tomorrow.

Allison: (whispering) I know, Sat... sorry...

Saturday: (softly) It's okay. We'll get through this together.

(There was a pause as Saturday continued to gently stroke Allison's hair)

Allison: (opening her eyes) You're so nice to me, Sat.

Saturday: (smiling softly) That's what girlfriends are for, Alli.

Allison: (looking up at me with her big brown eyes) But sometimes I feel like I'm so much trouble for you...

Saturday: (shaking my head) You're not a trouble, Alli. You're my partner, and I love you just the way you are.

Allison: (smiling slightly) Even when I'm being weird?

Saturday: (laughing softly) Especially when you're being weird, Alli. That's part of what makes me fall in love with you every day.

(Allison snuggled a bit closer to me, and I wrapped my arms around her)

Saturday: We've been through so much together, haven't we?

Allison: (nodding) Yeah...

Saturday: And we'll keep going through it all as long as we have each other.

Allison: (smiling more genuinely now) Yeah... you're right, Sat.
